description: This file defines a React component 'HolidaysView' for managing user holidays and out-of-office settings, including country selection, holiday toggling, conflict warnings, and UI rendering.

classes.name: CountrySelector
classes.description: A memoized React component for selecting a country, displaying flags and country names, with loading state handling.

classes.name: HolidayListItem
classes.description: A memoized React component representing a holiday item with name, date, emoji, and toggle switch.

classes.name: ConflictWarning
classes.description: A React component that displays a warning message if holiday booking conflicts are detected.

methods.name: HolidaysCTA
methods.description: A React component rendering a call-to-action section with an OutOfOfficeToggleGroup and an invisible placeholder button.

methods.name: getFlagEmoji
methods.description: Converts a country code into a flag emoji if valid.
